5	  SQUAWK_TERMINAL_STATUSES,
6	} from '@/lib/maintenance/status-constants';
7	import * as schema from '@/lib/schema';
8	import { and, count, eq, inArray, not } from 'drizzle-orm';

10	/**
11	 * Canonical sets for "what counts as an active squawk".
12	 *
13	 * Used to deduplicate filter logic across:
14	 *   - maybeUngroundEquipment (counts active grounding squawks/discs)
15	 *   - equipment-profile.tsx badge counter (KV-side)
16	 *   - PUT /maintenance grounding decision (KV-side)
17	 *   - any future reader that needs to ask "is this active right now"
18	 *
19	 * Drift between these filter sets is what produced the N1207H "phantom
20	 * duplicate" report on 2026-05-02 — the badge counted a voided em-record
21	 * because its filter only excluded ['completed','cancelled'].
22	 */

24	/**
25	 * Returns true if the equipment has any active grounding source — an open
26	 * grounding squawk, an open grounded_aog discrepancy, or an overdue inspection
27	 * that requires grounding. This is the canonical answer to "is this aircraft
28	 * currently grounded by data".
29	 */
30	async function hasActiveGroundingSource(
31	  equipmentId: string,
32	  orgId: string,
33	): Promise<boolean> {
34	  const [openSquawkRow] = await db
35	    .select({ n: count() })
36	    .from(schema.squawks)
37	    .where(
38	      and(
39	        eq(schema.squawks.equipmentId, equipmentId),
40	        eq(schema.squawks.flightSchoolId, orgId),
41	        eq(schema.squawks.groundAircraft, true),
42	        eq(schema.squawks.isDeleted, false),
43	        not(inArray(schema.squawks.status, [...SQUAWK_TERMINAL_STATUSES])),
44	      ),
45	    );
46	  if (Number(openSquawkRow?.n ?? 0) > 0) return true;
47	
48	  const [openDiscRow] = await db
49	    .select({ n: count() })
50	    .from(schema.maintenanceDiscrepancies)
51	    .where(
52	      and(
53	        eq(schema.maintenanceDiscrepancies.equipmentId, equipmentId),
54	        eq(schema.maintenanceDiscrepancies.flightSchoolId, orgId),
55	        eq(schema.maintenanceDiscrepancies.airworthiness, 'grounded_aog'),
56	        eq(schema.maintenanceDiscrepancies.isDeleted, false),
57	        not(
58	          inArray(schema.maintenanceDiscrepancies.status, [
59	            ...DISC_TERMINAL_STATUSES,
60	          ]),
61	        ),
62	      ),
63	    );
64	  if (Number(openDiscRow?.n ?? 0) > 0) return true;
65	
66	  const [eqRow] = await db
67	    .select({
68	      id: schema.equipment.id,
69	      hobbsTime: schema.equipment.hobbsTime,
70	      tachTime: schema.equipment.tachTime,
71	    })
72	    .from(schema.equipment)

74	      and(
75	        eq(schema.equipment.id, equipmentId),
76	        eq(schema.equipment.flightSchoolId, orgId),
77	      ),
78	    )
79	    .limit(1);
80	  if (!eqRow) return false;
